text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline in this channel at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. You described both inbound lanes as showing a white screen after badge scan.

The guard wrote trailer numbers on a clipboard while the kiosks were down. That was the stopgap from your 10:42 message until Mateo posted at 11:03 that kiosk 1 was back. Mateo said the guard then checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07.

The channel doesn't say what the guard did between 11:03 and 11:07. It also doesn't say how the guard handled lane 2 before 11:07.
